project_metadata.job_title: Luxury Content Creator for Business Pitches and Brochures
project_metadata.job_description: We are seeking a skilled content creator who specializes in crafting luxurious and captivating business pitches, brochures, and portfolios. The ideal candidate will have a keen eye for detail and the ability to convey our brand's values through high-quality content. Your work will be pivotal in impressing stakeholders and clients, so a strong background in luxury branding is essential. Please showcase your previous work that aligns with high-end demands.

so we’re on the same page. The initial discussion was only about image design, not a full monthly hiring arrangement, which honestly is not suitable for me at this stage.
We agreed on $100 for the work, which comes down to around $13 per image/page, but the amount of work and revisions requested has gone beyond what we originally discussed.
I’ve really tried to stay cooperative and made multiple changes, but repeatedly asking for major redesigns and calling the work “template-based” is not accurate. I have all the original source files, and everything has been created properly from scratch.
At this point, the scope has clearly increased. If you’d like to continue with further revisions or additional work, the cost will need to be adjusted accordingly. Otherwise, I won’t be able to continue with more changes under the same terms.
Thanks for understanding, and please let me know how you’d like to proceed.

After April 25, I will need to increase my charges, as I have already been working on this project for more than a month.
